column1: # The table of the decode: each label of my rows, the value that the decode gives it, and the source.
# Lookup: a unit is put in lower case, with the long s as s and a final ~ dropped (the switch f~ keeps
# its ~). scope: "all" for a code of 1 to 4 Latin letters or digits; <record>/<page> for a sign (and a
# digit read through a sign map), because my sign names change from page to page; look up the page
# One rule stands outside the table: v followed by db, and db after v, are the opener v db (no letter).
# kind: ledger key; added entry; clear word; clerk value (not in the ledger's key; shown [x], never
# counted as read); no value. Values of no letters (switch, opener, null) are "(none)". Where KS4 gives
# two values (njn = ha / han), the decode shows the value before the slash.
